narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On July 30, 2024, at approximately 1150 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered two men at a roofing job site in Kentwood, Michigan, after the property owner reported workers without identification. This record concerns one of them; the other is documented separately.
STATEMENTS:
[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he entered through the San Ysidro port of entry with a visitor visa in 2018 and stayed after it expired.
[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he has never had any immigration document.
Both men stated that they are citizens of Mexico.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notices to Appear.
